description: This source file contains functions related to managing enterprise key parameters, including setting key duration and organization ID based on team table metadata within a project managing key generation requests.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest add_team_organization_id( team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], data: GenerateKeyRequest, )
methods.description: Sets the organization ID in GenerateKeyRequest from the team table's organization ID.
